title: Waka okusama: Shûchi play
original_title: 若奥様 羞恥プレイ
overview: Izumi, a full-time housewife, has been married to Kenichi for three years. Raised by a strict father, she had come to equate being scolded with being loved. Kenichi, however, is incredibly indulgent toward her and never gets angry. Desperate to provoke his anger, Izumi repeatedly shoplifts at the supermarket, hoping to get caught by a security guard...
